sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
Three clear tanks. Three flavours at the same time such as mango, passion and orange, so customers choose and your sales increase.

Built in stirrers. Paddles keep the juice moving, which stops the pulp from settling and keeps the drink fresh looking and even.

Orange lids. Tight fitting lids protect the juice from dust and insects and are easy to lift for refilling.

Stainless steel base with vents. The base holds the pump or cooling parts and the vents let air flow, so the unit can run for long hours.

Countertop size. It fits on a counter or buffet table and plugs into a standard socket, so setup is quick.

sections.heading: What to Check Before Buying
sections.body: Confirm the tank sizes, whether you need chilling and the power supply. Leave space around the vents for airflow.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Empty the tanks, wash them and the stirrers with warm water and a soft brush, rinse and dry. Keep the vents free of dust.

sections.heading: In Practice
sections.body: Wash the tanks and stirrers before first use, then fill with chilled juice and fit the lids. Use the stirrers throughout service to stop pulp settling and keep the vent grille clear of dust and walls so air can circulate. At the end of the day, empty the tanks, rinse them and the taps with warm water, and leave the lids off to dry.
